title: Cookie bites come from the wrong side
description: Fabio 2026-11-22: his mouth eats from the top of the cookie, but the bites remove it from the bottom. Move the bites to the top edge (BITES in eyebot/hooks/draw/cookies/cookie.ts, y negative, e.g. [-4.5,-7.2],[0,-8.4],[4.5,-7.2]) and check the gulp direction (cgulp translateY) and crumbs still fit. Preview with tools/preview.mjs + a real click.
